note: 開得很穩 = conduire en douceur
noteEn: 開得很穩 = to drive smoothly.

example.pinyin: nǐ kāi chē kāi de hěn wěn
zhè ge yuè bān cì hěn wěn dìng
example.fr: Ce mois-ci, les horaires sont très stables.
example.en: This month the schedule has been very stable.

note: lu jì pour « attacher » ; xì dans 聯繫 (contacter)
noteEn: Read jì for 'to tie'; xì in 聯繫 (to contact).

example.pinyin: hǎo de qǐng jì ān quán dài
example.fr: D'accord, attachez votre ceinture, s'il vous plaît.

note: plus formel que 藥 ; 藥物過敏 = allergie médicamenteuse
noteEn: More formal than 藥; 藥物過敏 = drug allergy.

example.pinyin: zhè shì yì zhǒng yào wù guò mǐn
example.en: This is a kind of drug allergy.

en: to turn off, to switch off

example.zh: 對，出門前也要記得把冷氣關掉。
example.pinyin: duì chū mén qián yě yào jì de bǎ lěng qì guān diào
example.fr: Oui, et il faut aussi penser à éteindre la clim avant de sortir.
example.en: Yes, and we have to remember to turn the AC off before going out.

example.zh: 椅子躺太久，難免會這樣。
example.pinyin: yǐ zi tǎng tài jiǔ nán miǎn huì zhè yàng
example.fr: Rester allongé trop longtemps, c'est normal.
example.en: Lying in the chair too long, that's normal.

example.pinyin: lán zi ná qù zì jǐ tiāo
example.en: Take a basket and pick your own.

example.zh: 前面有一輛警車，在抓超速。
example.pinyin: qián miàn yǒu yí liàng jǐng chē zài zhuā chāo sù
example.fr: Il y a une voiture de police devant qui attrape les excès de vitesse.
example.en: There's a police car ahead catching speeders.

en: to look after, to mind (a shop, kids)
note: 顧店 = tenir la boutique ; ≈ 照顧
noteEn: 顧店 = to mind the store; ≈ 照顧.

example.zh: 你一個人顧店會寂寞嗎？
example.pinyin: nǐ yí ge rén gù diàn huì jì mò ma
example.fr: Vous vous sentez seul, tout seul dans le magasin ?
example.en: Do you get lonely running the store alone?

example.zh: 停車場旁邊有一個小攤子。
example.pinyin: tíng chē chǎng páng biān yǒu yí ge xiǎo tān zi
example.fr: Il y a un petit stand à côté du parking.
example.en: There's a little stall next to the parking lot.

example.pinyin: zhè ge tǐ wēn jì yǒu bǎo gù ma
example.en: Does this thermometer have a warranty?
